_notes: Northern Barrens boss + named-rare loot (2026-10-21). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make).

Foreman Grills.name: Foreman's Rivet-Hammer
Foreman Grills.flavor_text: A wrench-mallet with a head shaped like a rivet. It sorts problems into 'struck' and 'not yet struck'.

Foreman Grills.name: Venture Co. Hardhat
Foreman Grills.flavor_text: A dented iron hat with the company logo scraped half off. It has, evidently, been dropped on a lot of heads.

Foreman Grills.name: Blast-Proof Foreman's Apron
Foreman Grills.flavor_text: Heavy leather, singed to a shade of brown that no one ordered. Smells of pitch and grudges.

Foreman Grills.name: Tinkered Pressure-Gauge Pendant
Foreman Grills.flavor_text: A watch-sized gauge on a chain. The needle points to wherever someone is about to be hit.

Harpy Matriarch.name: Matriarch's Pinion Staff
Harpy Matriarch.flavor_text: A staff hung with grey flight feathers. In a wind it chimes, one note over and over.

Harpy Matriarch.name: Roost-Mother's Plumage Robe
Harpy Matriarch.flavor_text: A robe of layered feathers. Warm, and impossible to stop preening.

Harpy Matriarch.name: Skyreach Talons
Harpy Matriarch.flavor_text: A pair of curved harpy claws on a bone grip. They want to be thrown, and they're never quite sorry.

Harpy Matriarch.name: Cliff-Walker's Talonguards
Harpy Matriarch.flavor_text: Mail boots with a talon on each toe. You feel steadier in a gale, and a little predatory.

Serena Bloodfeather.name: Bloodfeather's Hunting Bow
Serena Bloodfeather.flavor_text: A recurve bow lashed with red-tipped feathers. It sings softly just before the string slips.

Serena Bloodfeather.name: Witchwing Hunter's Spaulders
Serena Bloodfeather.flavor_text: Leather pauldrons fringed with grey-and-crimson feathers. They flutter, with intent.

Serena Bloodfeather.name: Serena's Blood-Tipped Signet
Serena Bloodfeather.flavor_text: A ring of red-dyed bone. Wear it, and the sky seems closer, and slightly more hostile.

Serena Bloodfeather.name: Grimoire of Borrowed Weather
Serena Bloodfeather.flavor_text: Instructions for rain. The rain is not consulted.
Serena Bloodfeather.label: Tome (Spi)

Supervisor Lugwizzle.name: Lugwizzle's Spill-Proof Buckler
Supervisor Lugwizzle.flavor_text: A round shield with a drip-tray on the rim. It was supposed to catch oil. It catches other things.

Supervisor Lugwizzle.name: Control-Room Toolbelt
Supervisor Lugwizzle.flavor_text: A heavy belt hung with wrenches. Every one of them has a slightly different opinion about who was in charge.

Supervisor Lugwizzle.name: Signet of Quarterly Targets
Supervisor Lugwizzle.flavor_text: A brass ring stamped 'APPROVED'. It never says by whom.

Engineer Whirleygig.name: Whirleygig's Sheep-Launcher
Engineer Whirleygig.flavor_text: A rifle-sized launcher with a small wool-covered hopper. Do not ask what is in the hopper.

Engineer Whirleygig.name: Gadgeteer's Goggles
Engineer Whirleygig.flavor_text: Brass goggles with seven lenses, all slightly different shades of wrong. You see farther. You see worse.

Engineer Whirleygig.name: Tinker's Spark-Stitched Gloves
Engineer Whirleygig.flavor_text: Cloth gloves with copper thread in the fingertips. They tingle during a thunderstorm.

Verog the Dervish.name: Verog's Whirling Scimitar
Verog the Dervish.flavor_text: A curved blade, balanced for a spin. Verog's grip left a groove in the handle the size of a thumb.

Verog the Dervish.name: Dervish-Stalker's Leggings
Verog the Dervish.flavor_text: Dust-colored leather leggings that cut the wind. You'll find sand in them for weeks.

Verog the Dervish.name: Stagnant Oasis Talisman
Verog the Dervish.flavor_text: A charm of tarnished brass on a leather thong. It smells strongly of a pond that has seen things.

Captain Saltspray.name: Saltspray's Boarding Cutlass
Captain Saltspray.flavor_text: A cutlass with a barnacle-crusted guard. The point has seen more ropes than ribs, which is unusual for a pirate.

Captain Saltspray.name: Captain's Salt-Stained Tricorn
Captain Saltspray.flavor_text: A tricorn bent into a permanent defiant tilt. It's never dry, and it's never apologized.

Captain Saltspray.name: Southsea Doubloon Ring
Captain Saltspray.flavor_text: A heavy gold ring stamped with a skull that is just slightly too happy.

Old Mire-Maw.name: Mire-Maw's Hide Cloak
Old Mire-Maw.flavor_text: A cloak cut from the mud-brown hide of something that really, really liked its mud.

Old Mire-Maw.name: Snapper-Tooth Dagger
Old Mire-Maw.flavor_text: A tooth the length of your hand, notched for the grip. It still smells slightly of fen.

Old Mire-Maw.name: Boglord's Band
Old Mire-Maw.flavor_text: A ring of pressed peat and old bone. It keeps its shape through the wettest week.

Skyfang the Plunderer.name: Skyfang's Pinion Wand
Skyfang the Plunderer.flavor_text: A wand tipped with a single dark primary feather. Static pops off it when anyone lies nearby.

Skyfang the Plunderer.name: Plunderer's Talon Gloves
Skyfang the Plunderer.flavor_text: Fingerless leather gloves, each knuckle capped with a harpy talon. Excellent for picking pockets and fights.

Skyfang the Plunderer.name: Windrider's Cloak
Skyfang the Plunderer.flavor_text: A long grey cloak that never quite sits flat. In a gale it lifts you a little, spiritually.

Warden Ilthae.name: Ilthae's Moonglaive
Warden Ilthae.flavor_text: A silver-edged glaive that cuts cleaner than it should. It does not like the Barrens at all.

Warden Ilthae.name: Sentinel's Moonweave Mantle
Warden Ilthae.flavor_text: Pale cloth woven with something that is not thread. It cools, like a hand laid on your shoulder.

Warden Ilthae.name: Warden's Quiver-Belt
Warden Ilthae.flavor_text: A belt of dark leather with a hidden quiver at the back. A night-elf waistline in every way that matters.

Scout-Captain Vrek.name: Vrek's Scout-Longbow
Scout-Captain Vrek.flavor_text: A tall bow of horn and sinew. Built to be shot from a galloping centaur, and good at the other thing too.

Scout-Captain Vrek.name: Kolkar Hide Bracers
Scout-Captain Vrek.flavor_text: Hide bracers dyed with red clay and a thousand miles of road.

Scout-Captain Vrek.name: Wind-Bell Ring
Scout-Captain Vrek.flavor_text: A ring with a tiny bell. When you run it chimes, and the centaurs call that 'being found'.

Kragg the Wall-Breaker.name: Wallbreaker's Maul
Kragg the Wall-Breaker.flavor_text: A two-handed maul with a head the size of a gate. It was built for gates. It's open to other suggestions.

Kragg the Wall-Breaker.name: Siege-Plate Vambraces
Kragg the Wall-Breaker.flavor_text: Plate vambraces cut from a Kolkar siege-ram's iron shoulder. They have a deep, satisfied clang.

Kragg the Wall-Breaker.name: Kolkar War-Charm
Kragg the Wall-Breaker.flavor_text: A charm of horn and iron. Each notch is a wall. There are many notches.

Prospector Delvik.name: Delvik's Blasting Pick
Prospector Delvik.flavor_text: A pickaxe with a tiny fuse-holder in the haft. A prospector does not so much dig as persuade.

Prospector Delvik.name: Prospector's Dented Hardhat
Prospector Delvik.flavor_text: A dented mining helmet with a candle-bracket. It is almost always still faintly warm.

Prospector Delvik.name: Dynamite Bandolier
Prospector Delvik.flavor_text: A bandolier of empty dynamite loops. The full ones are, wisely, not included.

Windcaller Skreeva.name: Skreeva's Gale-Wand
Windcaller Skreeva.flavor_text: A wand carved from a harpy wing-bone. The shriek, when it casts, is very much on purpose.

Windcaller Skreeva.name: Windspeaker's Cowl
Windcaller Skreeva.flavor_text: A feathered cowl that muffles every sound except wind. Spellcasting in it feels like speaking in a gale.

Windcaller Skreeva.name: Featherbound Mending-Bracers
Windcaller Skreeva.flavor_text: Cloth bracers bound with small, warm feathers. Wounds nearby close a little faster, and a little reluctantly.
